issuer: the Departamento de Tránsito of the Policía Nacional Civil, at its licence centres (Maycom)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Departamento de Tránsito's site. Primera Licencia: a first type C (car), M or E licence needs the DPI for adults or, for minors who have turned 16, a RENAP birth certificate, a parent's or guardian's notarised letter of responsibility and payment for one year (Q100.00); every applicant needs a driving school's theory and practical test certificate, an eye test and payment for the years of validity wanted. Licencia para menores says the same of drivers between 16 and 18. The licence after the tests is the same type C licence for both, so it is held from 16: a reading, as the minor's needs a parent's letter and is paid a year at a time. Información General de Licencias: one year Q100, two Q185, three Q260, four Q320, five Q390; until 2026-10-30 the one-year licence, the term open to a minor, was held alone with its fee (Q100, 1 year); from then the five terms are held as the holder's choice, Q100 to Q390 (the longer terms cost less a year, so the fee isn't by the year). A minor's permit is paid a year at a time (the pages' 'Comprobante de pago por un año (Q.100.00)' for 16 to 18): from 2026-10-30 (the lead, when a term could carry the ages it's sold to) the two- to five-year terms are held from 18, the one-year term for every holder. No identity card is held (the DPI is RENAP's, the ids engine's); foreigners' licences weren't read into an exchange list.
